AC amendment (gap-analysis): id-uniqueness — validate-corpus.py MUST assert corpus entry 'id' values are unique (id is the stable join key sc-3/sc-6 bind against; a duplicate id silently shadows a fixture). 
  Verify: T=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/corpus.XXXXXX") && python3 -c "import yaml,sys; e=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml')); assert isinstance(e,list); e.append(dict(e[0])); yaml.safe_dump(e,open(sys.argv[1],'w'))" "$T" && python3 tests/runners/fixtures/validate-corpus.py "$T"; RC=$?; rm -f "$T"; [ $RC -ne 0 ]  (duplicate id -> non-zero). Also: README documents 'id' as the downstream consumer join key.
